definitions.gloss: labor shortage, staff shortage, being short-handed
definitions.explanation: A condition where there are not enough workers or staff to meet demand. A widely discussed social issue in Japan due to the aging population and declining birthrate.

examples.japanese: {人手不足|ひとでぶそく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{深刻|しんこく}→深刻：01567_shinkoku⟧だ。
{人手不足|ひとでぶそく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{閉|し}める→閉める：00485_shimeru⟧ことになった。
examples.english: Due to a staff shortage, we had to close the shop.

examples.japanese: ⟦{介護|かいご}→介護：04805_kaigo⟧⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{慢性的|まんせいてき}な{人手不足|ひとでぶそく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: A chronic labor shortage continues in the nursing care industry.

notes:
USAGE: A four-character compound consisting of ⟦{人手|ひとで}→人手：25438_hitode⟧ (manpower, workers) and {不足|ぶそく} (shortage, insufficiency). Very frequently appears in news and business contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人手不足|ひとでぶそく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解消|かいしょう}する→解消する：21324_kaishousuru⟧ (to resolve a labor shortage)
- {人手不足|ひとでぶそく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悩|なや}む→悩む：02380_nayamu⟧ (to struggle with a staff shortage)
- {慢性的|まんせいてき}な{人手不足|ひとでぶそく} (chronic labor shortage)
- ⟦{深刻|しんこく}→深刻：01567_shinkoku⟧な{人手不足|ひとでぶそく} (severe labor shortage)
